title: Drums
description: Plays a drum pattern with the samples of a drum kit folder of the project, triggered by the pattern you write (and optionally by notes). It needs a kit (a sample set) and gives audio.

parameters.name: kit
parameters.doc: A sample kit (a folder of the project with WAV files) or the built-in sound.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.doc: Pattern or kit definition. Use the expanded editor for longer definitions.

parameters.name: bars
parameters.doc: Length of the drum block in bars.

parameters.name: swing
parameters.doc: Swing amount in percent; 0 keeps the grid straight.

parameters.name: choke
parameters.doc: Choke rules, separated by ;. The voice before the colon is cut (short fade) by a hit of any voice after it, for example open:hat,pedal cuts an open hat when a closed or pedal hat is struck.

parameters.name: map
parameters.doc: Replace a voice of the kit by a sample of another kit folder: the voice, a colon, the folder, a slash and the sample name, entries separated by ;.

parameters.name: fallback
parameters.doc: A kit folder used for voices the kit does not have (a warning, AMP5256, says so). Without it a missing voice is an error.

parameters.name: humanize
parameters.doc: Deterministic timing and velocity variation in percent.

parameters.name: patterns
parameters.doc: Named patterns, separated by /: name=pattern, for example verse=D...D.u. / fill=DdDdDdDd. A song (the next parameter) puts them in order.

parameters.name: song
parameters.doc: The sections in order: a pattern name with an optional number of bars, for example verse*4 fill chorus*8. The word pattern is the plain pattern of the block. The sequence repeats when the block is longer. Empty: the plain pattern plays on every bar.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: Nothing for the built-in kit (kit builtin). For your own sounds: a drum kit, a sample set folder of the project (parameter kit); an optional second set as fallback.
